contract.task: Estimate the actual productivity ratio of a garment-production team using the supplied production-context measurements.
contract.context: date: calendar date; quarter: source within-month segment, not a calendar quarter; department: production department; team: categorical team number; targeted_productivity: management target ratio; smv: standard minutes allocated to a task; wip: unfinished-item count; over_time: team overtime minutes; no_of_style_change: style-change count; no_of_workers: recorded staffing quantity, which may be fractional. This is a retrospective conditional estimate, not a guaranteed pre-shift forecast. The target can exceed 1 in the observed source records.
contract.group_note: All teams on the same date are grouped; time must be respected when splitting.

grouping_rule: All teams on the same date are grouped; time must be respected when splitting. Identical prepared inputs are additionally unioned to prevent duplicate-input leakage.
deduplication_policy: One example per identical task/input/label; source_refs and duplicate_count preserve multiplicity. Different labels retained.
missing_policy: null; no statistical imputation; two nonpositive Abalone heights and ten nonpositive Metro Kelvin temperatures are converted to null in their respective sources.
split_policy: UNASSIGNED: choose dataset-family holdouts and appropriate grouped/chronological splits before training. group_id prevents known overlap but does not prove independence.

license.name: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the UCI dataset page

citation_paper.title: Mining the productivity data of the garment industry
citation_paper.authors: Abdullah Al Imran, Md Shamsur Rahim, Tanvir Ahmed
citation_paper.venue: International Journal of Business Intelligence and Data Mining

quality_findings.detail: Observed productivity can exceed 1; do not clip labels or constrain output to [0,1].
Missing WIP is confined to finishing department; do not replace with zero.
Remove incentive and idle variables. Remaining production measures are used for conditional estimation, not claimed available pre-shift.
Different targets for the same input can represent noise or unobserved variables; they are not averaged or deleted.
Identical task/input/label examples are stored once with duplicate_count. This is a deduplication policy, not proof that all originals are erroneous.

source_values_policy: No learned feature scaling, target normalization, truncation, oversampling or label clipping; unknown physical units explicitly identified.

numeric_precision.rule: Non-integral finite floats rounded to at most 12 significant decimal digits; integers, null and strings unchanged; no fixed decimal-place rounding or clipping.

prepared_profile_scope: Original prepared table before task deduplication/label exclusions, retained from v2.0.0.
distribution_format: UTF-8 JSON Lines, gzip compressed, at most 100000 records per shard
